scope.edition: 2016 base/core multiplayer rules represented by the recovered English 32-page rulebook
scope.included: Complete gameplay summary: setup, turn flow, all normal actions, movement/control/resources, five factions and all mech abilities, combat, encounters, Factory, objectives/agreements, stars, immediate end, all scoring rates, all six structure bonus tiles and tiebreakers.
excluded: optional variants including Delay of Game
scope.minor_scope_note: The candidate includes the rulebook tournament coin-exchange caveat; this is accurately identified as tournament-only and does not replace the ordinary multiplayer rule.

method.full_text_review: Read the complete 1656-line extraction. Independently compared whitespace-normalized extracted text with fitz text from every one of the 32 PDF pages; all 32 matched.
method.visual_checks: Inspected supplied source-only page images 13, 19 and 29, and temporary PDF renders of pages 10 and 14, to verify production icons, exact recruit icons, upgrade box conventions, all six tile payout bands and the full popularity scoring track.
method.finding_standard: PASS requires no identified material false claim or important omission within the specified core multiplayer scope. Routine mat/card details may be delegated to the physical mat/card where the summary explicitly says to use them.

checked_claims.checked: Individual clockwise turns without rounds; sixth-star immediate ending; richest player wins.

Seaworthy lake movement and adjacent-lake retreat, transported worker rules; Artillery optional one power for opposing two power once per combat.

Submerge all-lake adjacency and movement; Camaraderie specifically aggressive combat victory, not undefended worker displacement; no Nordic lake-retreat privilege.

Held coins plus stars/territories/complete resource pairs and selected structure tile; resource pooling; lakes score, bases do not; Factory three total; all three popularity tiers/rates visually verified on page 29; arithmetic example recomputed as 20+21+12=53.

Each feature definition and every payout band checked against rendered page 19; tunnels exclude Mines; unique adjacent locations; encounter presence not needed; longest straight continuous row; farm+tundra combined; no zero-feature payout; rivers do not break adjacency/continuity; control not required.
Most total coins; workers+mechs+structures excluding character, power, popularity, controlled resources, controlled territories, stars in exact order.

After all moves/before bottom; attacker chooses multiple-combat order; zero power/popularity permitted; attacker mech ability first; dial 0..min(7,current power); one card per character/mech plus Rusviet exception; simultaneous reveal; attacker wins tie.

Both pay dial and discard all used cards face-up; card power not deducted from track; winner takes territory/resources and eligible star; all losing units retreat without resources; offensive worker popularity loss, defensive exemption; one loser card only after positive revealed power.

Character-only stop; after all moves/combats before bottom; lost fight leaves token; card shown/art/thematic text; affordable paid option with optional benefits; benefit placement on encounter hex; isolated cost/benefits and no ongoing recruit; face-down bottom discard.

Each character first finishing Move on Factory must choose one available card after combat; permanent one-card limit; fifth section with ordinary top/bottom order and Rusviet repeat exception; no Player Mat coins/structure/recruit benefits; one-unit two-step Move or three with Speed, Mine and normal stops.

Own-turn objective reveal only at top/bottom boundaries while fully satisfying requirements; optional delay; both cards bottom-discarded except Saxony retained objective; unenforceable agreements, coin-only exchanges, stated tournament caveat, no cancellation of initiated combat.
Reference repeats the validated action costs, turn order, after-Move sequence and scoring without introducing a conflicting rule.

limits: The supplied rulebook does not reproduce every objective, encounter and Factory card or all five complete physical Player Mats. Individual card texts and all mat-specific costs are therefore not independently inventoried; the candidate explicitly directs play to those printed components and correctly states their governing rules.
No external source, later clarification or optional/solo/expansion material was used to change the recovered rulebook scope.
